## At Comprehensive Pain Specialists, our dedicated team of **[healthcare professionals](https://comprehensivepaindocs.org/our-team)** is committed to the art of pain management. We focus on diagnosing, managing, and treating chronic pain conditions. Our services cover a wide range of painful conditions, including back pain, neck pain, chronic pain, spinal cord stimulation, facet joint injections, epidural steroid injections, post surgical pain treatment, complex regional pain syndrome, joint pain treatment, and much more. For more information, **[contact us](https://comprehensivepaindocs.org/contact)** or book an **[appointment online](https://comprehensivepaindocs.org/appointments)**. We are located at **[1177 PA-315, Dolphin Plaza, Wilkes-Barre, PA 18702](https://comprehensivepaindocs.org/get-directions)**. We serve patients from Wilkes-Barre PA, Glen Lyon PA, Dallas PA, Pittston PA, Mountain Top PA, Plymouth PA, and surrounding areas.

To Relieve You Of Your Pain

Pain has many causes and just as many treatment options. For many patients, simply getting the correct diagnosis and choosing the best treatment can be a long and frustrating process.
